description: Create a new collection in Zotero with the EXACT name 'Machine Learning Papers' (without quotes). Then import the RIS file machine_learning_papers.ris from /home/ga/Documents/ into your library. After importing, move or organize the imported papers into the Machine Learning Papers collection. The task is complete when the collection exists in the left sidebar and contains the imported papers (you should see 7-8 papers in the collection when you click on it).
